text:
Jake: FYI customer 'AcmePay' reports function-call args getting truncated when the response stream resumes after a short network hiccup. They see the JSON end mid-brace, parser fails and we return a 400 to them.

Jake: Attaching the raw SSE chunks they captured (redacted):
```
data: {\n  \"tool_call\": {\n    \"name\": \"charge\",\n    \"args\": {\n      \"amount\": 100,\n      \"currency\": \"USD\"\n    }\n```
(then on resume)
```
data: , \"metadata\": {\"id\": \"abc123\"}}\n```
So the closing brace for args is split across the resume boundary and our streaming JSON reassembly yields malformed JSON (missing a comma/braces ordering). Customer says it repros ~1/20 calls when they have intermittent client-side mobile network blips.

Sam: Can you paste the request id + model + SDK version? Any gateway/proxy between client and our edge?

Jake: Request id: r-2026-07-acmepay-58, model: redwood-chat-1b, SDK: js@4.2.1, client behind customer proxy (nginx) and then our API LB. I've attached the trace id to the ticket: trace: trace-7701.

Marta: Thanks. Quick guess: reassembly logic in our SSE handler might be emitting events as soon as a partial JSON chunk looks like it contains a tool_call key instead of buffering until the full event delimiter.

Marta: Repro steps I used locally (node fetch streaming):
```
const res = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', body: promptStream });
for await (const chunk of res.body) { processChunk(chunk); }
```
If you simulate a split at a UTF-8 multi-byte boundary or explicitly cut after the args closing brace, parser throws. I can push a small repro script to the ticket.

Elaine: Could be affected by our edge chunk splitter + the proxy injecting chunk-size re-chunking. Ops: can we check nginx proxy config for proxy_buffering and chunked_transfer settings for that customer route? Also check whether our LB strips CRLF differently on resume paths.

replay-bot: Automated trace upload: https://replay.internal/trace-7701 (contains the exact raw bytes, expires in 48h) :eyes:

Sam: Short-term mitigation: recommend customer enable 'buffered_response:true' on their SDK to avoid streaming tool_call events, or set a client-side retry that waits for stream-end. I'll draft a note for support.

Marta: Longer-term: runtime should accumulate SSE data for tool_call events until a full top-level JSON object is seen (balanced braces) before emitting. Also tolerate a leading comma on resume (some clients send separator in a separate chunk). I'll open a PR to the SSE parser to do brace-matching and simple recovery for common split patterns.

Elaine: I'll create an incident (INC-2026-118) and assign to eng-runtime, label 'high-customer-impact' — customer is on production payment flow. Ops will also review proxy config for that account.

Jake: Thanks all — I'll reply to AcmePay with the buffered_response workaround and ETA that eng-runtime will investigate. Will update ticket with incident number. :thumbsup:

Sam: Thanks. If anyone can attach the small repro script and the trace link to INC-2026-118 that speeds triage.

Marta: Pushed repro gist to the ticket and started a draft PR with tests for split-chunk JSON. Will ping once CI passes.

Jake: Great, keeping customer informed.
